description.zh: 把一台 ComfyUI(本机或局域网)接进 Mosael:它保存的每张工作流既是一个图像 / 视频生成模型,也是一个工具(「工作流 · 名字」,入参就是那张图自己的提示词、读素材的节点和可调参数,交回全部产出)。另有列出工作流与模型文件、看显卡和队列、把历史产出收进素材库、中断 / 清队列 / 释放显存。
description.en: Connect a ComfyUI server (local or on your LAN): every saved workflow is both an image / video generation model and a tool (“Workflow · name”, whose inputs are that graph's own prompts, loader nodes and tunable parameters, returning every output). Plus listing workflows and model files, GPU and queue status, importing past outputs into the asset library, and interrupt / clear queue / free VRAM.

help.zh: 本机默认是 http://127.0.0.1:8188;填局域网地址就能用另一台机器的显卡。多台服务器就建多个连接。
help.en: http://127.0.0.1:8188 on this machine; a LAN address uses another machine's GPU. One connection per server.

help.zh: 转换认不出的工作流的退路:在 ComfyUI 里「导出 (API)」,把得到的 JSON 贴在这里,它在模型列表里叫「API 模板」。可用占位符 `{{prompt}}` `{{negative}}` `{{seed}}` `{{width}}` `{{height}}` `{{steps}}`。
help.en: A fallback for workflows the converter can't read: use “Export (API)” in ComfyUI and paste the JSON here; it appears as “API template” in the model list. Placeholders: `{{prompt}}` `{{negative}}` `{{seed}}` `{{width}}` `{{height}}` `{{steps}}`.

help.zh: ComfyUI 放在要登录的反向代理或 ComfyUI-Login 后面时才填:`用户名:密码` 按 Basic 认证发,别的按 `Bearer` 令牌发。本机和局域网里直接开着的 ComfyUI 不用填。
help.en: Only for a ComfyUI behind a reverse proxy with login or ComfyUI-Login: `user:password` is sent as Basic auth, anything else as a `Bearer` token. Leave empty for a ComfyUI running directly on this machine or your LAN.

description.zh: 替 Mosael 在这台 ComfyUI 上列出模型与工具(每张工作流一个)、做一次生成。只给宿主调。
description.en: Lists models and tools (one per workflow) and runs generations on this ComfyUI server for Mosael. Host-only.

description.zh: 这台 ComfyUI 上的每张工作流(连同内置文生图和粘贴的 API 模板):能喂什么(图 / 蒙版 / 视频 / 音频各接在哪个节点)、能调什么、会交出什么、看起来在做什么(放大、局部重绘、抠图…),以及跑它用哪个工具(`tool`,「工作流 · 名字」,入参就是它自己的节点)。
description.en: Every workflow on this ComfyUI (plus the built-in text-to-image and a pasted API template): what it takes (which node loads each image / mask / video / audio), what can be tuned, what it outputs, what it seems to do (upscale, inpaint, background removal…), and which tool runs it (`tool`, “Workflow · name”, whose inputs are that workflow's own nodes).

description.zh: 只看 id 或名字里带这几个字的
description.en: Only workflows whose id or name contains this

description.zh: 把 ComfyUI 历史里的产出收进素材库:给任务号就取那一个(还在跑可以等一会儿),不给就取最近几次。在 ComfyUI 界面里跑出来的东西也能这样拿回来。
description.en: Imports outputs from ComfyUI's history into the asset library: a task id fetches that one (optionally waiting while it runs), otherwise the most recent runs. Also works for things run directly in the ComfyUI interface.

description.zh: 任务号(工作流工具交回的 `prompt_id`,或 ComfyUI 历史里的);不填就按「最近几次」
description.en: A task id (the `prompt_id` a workflow tool returned, or one from ComfyUI's history); empty = most recent runs

description.zh: 不给任务号时取最近几次,默认 1
description.en: Without a task id: how many recent runs, default 1

description.zh: 任务还没跑完时最多等几秒,默认不等
description.en: How long to wait for an unfinished task, default 0

description.zh: 也取回预览节点的临时文件
description.en: Also collect temporary files from preview nodes

description.zh: ComfyUI 的版本、显卡与空闲显存、内存,以及队列里在跑 / 排队的任务数。
description.en: ComfyUI version, GPU and free VRAM, RAM, and how many tasks are running / queued.

description.zh: 服务器上装了哪些模型文件,按目录分:checkpoints、loras、vae、upscale_models、controlnet、diffusion_models…
description.en: Model files installed on the server by folder: checkpoints, loras, vae, upscale_models, controlnet, diffusion_models…

description.zh: 只看这一个目录,如 loras
停下 ComfyUI 正在跑的任务。给了任务号就只停那一个(在跑的中断,排队的删掉),不会误伤别人的任务。
description.en: Stops the task ComfyUI is running. With a task id only that one is stopped (interrupted if running, removed if queued), leaving other people's tasks alone.

description.zh: 清掉 ComfyUI 里所有**排队中**的任务(在跑的不动)。同一台服务器上别人排的任务也会被清掉。
description.en: Clears every **queued** task in ComfyUI (the running one is untouched). Tasks queued by other people on the same server are cleared too.

description.zh: 让 ComfyUI 卸载模型、释放显存。下一次生成要重新加载模型,会慢一些。
description.en: Asks ComfyUI to unload models and free VRAM. The next run reloads its models and is slower.
